note_text:
CC: follow up plantar fasciitis with new lateral foot pain

HPI: 6 months of symptoms relating to multiple painful calluses. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation. Sensory neuropathy noted on prior visits. Peripheral vascular disease noted.

Exam: plantar callus area consistent with multiple painful calluses; no other findings recorded.

MDM: discussed risks and benefits of the planned procedure; patient consents.

Procedure: Paring of multiple hyperkeratotic lesions performed. Tolerated well, no immediate complications.

(End of note.)
